name: Abelardo de la Espriella
quote: La tierra tembló, pero Colombia no se quebró.

name: Miguel Gómez Martínez
quote: We will seek up to $450 million in financing from the World Bank to accelerate reconstruction.

name: Javier Pava
quote: Yo sí acepté la ayuda — mi posición inicial reflejaba solo las necesidades de las primeras horas.

name: David Santiago Tamayo
quote: We are widening our acceptance of international search and rescue support as the response enters its next phase.

name: Colombian Red Cross
quote: Our teams are deployed to Antioquia, Quindío, Caldas and Chocó, supporting shelter, water and first-aid needs.

name: Colombian Armed Forces
role: Military engineering and public order deployment
quote: More than 1,000 soldiers and military engineers have been deployed to Cali to support search operations and maintain order.

name: World Bank
quote: We are providing $200 million in emergency financing to support Colombia's immediate recovery needs.

name: United Nations (OCHA)
quote: The UN is joining the national response to support the government's coordination of humanitarian assistance.

name: Israeli Rescue Delegation
role: IDF / Foreign Affairs Ministry search-and-rescue team
quote: Our 80-person delegation is on the ground in Cali to support search and rescue operations.

name: U.S. Embassy in Colombia
quote: The United States is providing $26.5 million in relief assistance to support earthquake response efforts.

name: Alcaldía de Cali
quote: We have established a citywide donation collection center and shelter network as search operations continue.

name: Gobernación de Risaralda
quote: Pereira's shelters at Olaya Herrera park and the Alberto Mora Mora stadium are providing food, water and sanitation to over a thousand displaced residents.

name: Shakira
quote: I'm committing $1 million and the construction of 10 new schools, including support to rebuild the University of Chocó.

name: Asociación Nacional de Empresarios de Colombia (ANDI)
quote: Colombian businesses have raised more than $64 million for earthquake relief and reconstruction.

name: Government of Ecuador
quote: We have offered a 47-member search and rescue team to support Colombia's response.

name: Jaime Gilinski & Raquel Kardonski de Gilinski
quote: Our contribution is focused on Cali — hospitales, los centros de salud y especialmente los colegios.

name: Grupo Aval, Banco GNB Sudameris, Grupo Bolívar & Bancolombia
quote: Agreed to cut housing loan rates to 8% effective annual for earthquake victims — a decision President de la Espriella thanked publicly: "Aceptaron. Mi gratitud por esta decisión."

name: Argentine Armed Forces
quote: We deployed 32 soldiers along with a water purification plant, field kitchen and 4,000 food rations to support communities in Quibdó, Chocó.

name: Beyoncé
quote: I'm personally donating $1 million through Parkwood Entertainment to Food For The Poor and World Central Kitchen for food and housing relief in Chocó and Valle del Cauca.

name: José Manuel Restrepo
quote: We are identifying the needs ahead of the reconstruction plan for Caldas, which could cost up to COP 1.4 trillion.

name: CAF (Banco de Desarrollo de América Latina)
quote: We're going to project about USD 50 million from the bank to prioritize the execution of school construction in Chocó.
